Commentary.Commentary: So 161 to get, it should be an easy chase for England. Afghanistan will need to bowl out of their skin if they want to even make a fight out of this. Join us in a while for the second innings.

Ben Stokes is caught for a chat. He states it was a good performance from the boys on the field. Says the two warm-up games being so close to each other makes a difference when one comes back so well after the earlier defeat. When asked about fitness, Ben admits that their bodies might be a little tired as they have been playing cricket continuously now, talks about the Pakistan series. Reckons Adil Rashid's shoulder looks fine now. Feels that it was important for them to have an excellent start with the ball as Afghanistan are good early on with the bat. Signs off by saying it is vital to have a third spinner some days and it was nice to see Joe Root picking up wickets.

As for England's bowling, 7 bowlers were used by them. With Jofra Archer and Joe Root picking up 3 each. Moeen Ali and Ben Stokes were the others to get into the wicket column with one a piece. Overall everyone was good for England with the ball but they will be slightly disappointed not to restrict Afghanistan under 140.

After winning the toss, England skipper Eoin Morgan put Afghanistan to bat. The innings did not start brightly for the visitors. They kept losing wickets at regular intervals. Though opener Noor Ali Zadran got a good start he could not convert it. They lost half their side for 88. Mohammad Nabi then played a good hand with the tail and gave them something to bowl and took the total to 160.

Comprehensive performance with the ball from England. Though they will feel they should have restricted them under 150 but Nabi's 44 has taken Afghanistan over 150 and has given them something to bowl at.

OUT! The foot is okay says the third umpire. He will remain with the soft signal and AFGHANISTAN END WITH 160 on board. What an excellent catch that is in the deep! This is brilliant from Bairstow. Not even 40 overs they have played. The last ball is a short one outside off, Nabi looks to cut but the ball flies off the top edge and to third man. Bairstow initially takes the catch just inside the rope but realising that he would lose balance, throws the ball in the air, takes a step out before coming back in to complete the catch coolly. Well done, YJB! Archer ends with 3 wickets.
Nabi is caught at third man by Bairstow. The umpire wants to check whether Bairstow has stepped on the rope and hence takes the decision upstairs. The soft signal is OUT!
Good comeback! Archer sees Nabi back away and hence bowls a slower ball following the batsman. Nabi has to adjust and can only pat it away towards cover.
FOUR! Top edged and four! Short ball on off, Nabi looks to pull this away but the ball goes off the top edge and flies over the slip region. Too fine for third man to come around.
A length ball on top of off stump, defended back to the bowler by Nabi.
Jofra Archer is back on.
FOUR! Smashed and smashed hard. Moeen bowls it full on off, Dawlat hits it hard straight. The ball deflects off the umpire's leg and goes to the long fence for a boundary.
Moeen flights it on the stumps, Dawlat defends it off the front foot.
In the air but safe. Dawlat takes the aerial route and lofts it over the bowler's head. The ball falls in no man's land and they get a couple.
Outside off, Dawlat defends it towards cover.
Floated on middle, Dawlat taps it back to the bowler.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Nabi milks it to long on and gets a single. 150 comes up for Afghanistan with that single.
SIX! Huge! Zadran gets down low on one knee and slogs this ball outside off over long on. Brilliant shot from the number 11. These are valuable runs being added for the last wicket.
Leg spinner outside off, Zadran looks to drive this back to the cover fielder but misses as the ball turns away. Buttler fumbles behind the wickets.
Flatter leg spinner on off, Nabi comes ahead to defend the ball but it goes off the inside edge. A quick single is taken as the ball rolls towards the leg side.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
The batsman dances down the track and does well to block the ball towards cover by Mohammad.

Stifled appeal but no movement from the umpire. A flatter leg spinner outside off, Nabi looks to paddle this but fails to put bat on ball. He gets hit on the pad and it runs fine on the leg side. No run though. The quiet appeal is turned down.
This time finds the man at cover.
FOUR! What a shot from Dawlat. He has taken everyone by surprise there. Moeen bowls it full outside off, Dawlat smashes it through mid off for a boundary.
Outside off, Dawlat leaves it alone.
Unnecessary this. Tossed up on off, Nabi taps it back to the bowler. Moeen looks to flick it onto the stumps but misses and they take a run.
Outside off and short, Dawlat punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
The batsman has punched the ball off the backfoot.
Moeen Ali to continue...
Flatter outside off, Dawlat slaps it to sweeper cover and keeps the strike. Bold decision this to take the run of the last ball.
Flighted on off, Dawlat blocks it off his front foot.
Plays a premeditated paddle sweep to the leg spinning ball outside off. It goes towards short fine leg and they take a run.
On the pads, Nabi turns it fine of fine leg and gets a couple.

A slight stoppage in play as the physio comes out to have a look at Nabi who got hit on the neck on the previous ball while attempting to sweep. The umpire decides to take Drinks as well! England are right on top here having picked up wickets at quick intervals and they have just one more to pick up for them to bowl out Afghanistan. Nabi is still out there though and he is the only hope for the Asian side to get anywhere close to a respectable total.

Ouch! That must have been hurt. Leg spinner pitching on off, Nabi looks to sweep it against the spin. He misses and the4 ball goes through the glove and hits him on his neck. He holds his neck in pain and this halt will call for drinks.
Leg spinner pitching on off, Nabi looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Adil Rashid comes back on with a change of ends.
Floats it on off, Nabi nudges it to mid on and takes a quick single to keep the strike.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Dawlat does well to stroke it to mid on and takes a single.
Short on the body, Nabi pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Tossed up on off, Nabi strokes it to mid on.
Once again short, Nabi once again punches it to the man at mid on.
Shorter on off, Nabi punches it to mid on.
Change of ends for Moeen Ali.
Nabi drives this through mid on for a single. He retains strike for the next over.
A high full toss on the hips, turned away to square leg by Zadran. A single is taken.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball to cover.
The last man in is Dawlat Zadran.

OUT! Aftab Alam has thrown it away and he did not need to. He just had to give strike to the more experienced player and better batsman at the non-striker's end. A flatter one outside off, Aftab comes down the track and looks to cut the ball away but it goes off outside edge of the bat and lobs in air. The backward point comes a little in to take the easiest of catches. One wicket away now England from bowling out the Asian side. Root has picked up 3 meanwhile!
Fired in quicker on middle, Nabi eases it down to the ground to long on for a single.
Leg spinner gone wrong, goes down the leg side. Wided by the umpire.
Short outside off, cut away to deep cover for a single by Alam.
Joe Root comes back on now. Meanwhile, we see good sportsmanship as Stokes ties the shoe laces for Aftab Alam.
Tossed up on off, Aftab strokes it to long off and gets a run.
On the stumps, Aftab defends it off the front foot.
Now takes a single by punching it through covers.
SIX! Flat and over. Nabi is not gonna die without trying. Rashid flights it outside off, Nabi demolishes it over cover for a maximum. The man in the deep can just watch it sail over his head.
On the pads, Alam turns it towards fine leg and gets one.
Flighted on off, Alam drives it to cover.
Takes the risk of taking two and gives the strike to Alam. Floated on off, Nabi drives it beautifully through covers. The sweeper cover gathers it and Nabi unselfishly takes two.
Flighted on middle, Nabi drives it back to the bowler. Moeen dives to his right and stops the ball.
Now calmly punches it to mid on.
The ball seems to have lost shape after that hit from Nabi. The fourth umpire is seen running in with the box of balls.

SIX! Second of the over and Nabi has decided to take on Moeen. He gives it air and bowls it slower outside off, Nabi gets on one knee and thrashes his sweep over the mid-wicket fence. It is a short boundary on that side but that went 3 rows back and would have been a six anywhere in the world. He hit it so hard that we will have to take the new ball.
Now hits it hard but straight to mid off.
SIX! Don't even bother looking that is six the moment it left the bat. Brilliant use of the feet. Nabi comes down the track and whacks this tossed up ball on off over long off for a biggie.
Shorter on the body, Alam looks to pull but gets hit on the body.
On the pads, Nabi flicks it towards mid-wicket and gets one.
On the pads, Nabi paddle sweeps it but finds short fine leg.
Floated on off, Nabi drives it straight to cover.
Skidder on middle, Nabi does really well to keep it out.
Short outside off, Nabi defends it off the back foot.
Maiden over! The flighted off spinner on off is kept out by Aftab Alam coming ahead.
Pushed through to mid-wicket by AA.
Ali fires a yorker in on middle, Aftab keeps this ball out somehow by getting his bat down on time.
Fired in outside off, driven hard to cover by Aftab. Does not get the placement on that well-time shot.
Alam comes ahead and defends this ball flighted outside off.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball back to the bowler.

Alam looks to pull this short ball but times it really poorly off the higher part of the willow. The ball goes to mid-wicket for a single who has a shy at the bowler's end. Misses. Cheers in the crowd as Afghanistan get to 100!
Another flatter one on middle, defended back to the bowler watchfully.
Flatter on middle, turned towards square leg for a run by Nabi.
Flighted outside off once more, Alam gets to the pitch of the ball by reaching out and pushes it to deep point for a run.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Flighted leg spinner outside off, Alam looks to drive this ball but fails to put bat on it.
It's been lofted over mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Flighted ball outside off, driven towards mid off a little uppishly.
Pushy defense through the cover-point region by Mohammad. Single taken.
Flighted off spinner outside off once more, Nabi comes ahead and defends it solidly.
Fuller ball outside off, driven towards mid-wicket by MN.
Flatter one outside off, paddle swept by Nabi down to fine leg for a couple of runs.
Tossed up on middle and off, Aftab does well to keep it off and see off the over.
Flights it on the stumps, Alam defends it.
Moeen Ali with a change of ends.
Short on the body, Aftab looks to pull but misses and gets hit on the body.
Googly outside off, Alam does well to read it and block it.
Short outside off, Aftab cuts it to the man at point.
Starts with a short ball outside off, Nabi strokes it to long off for a single.
Adil Rashid to have a go with the ball now.
Cut hard to the point fielder. Excellent over for England comes to an end, Afghanistan are 92/8 at the halfway mark of their innings.
Another leg spinner on off stump, Alam pats the ball towards cover.
Aftab Alam is the new man in.

OUT! Two wickets in two balls. Rashid Khan departs first ball. Root has his second wicket. A flatter leg spinner on the off stump line, Rashid backs away to cut but the ball flies to the right of slip off the thick outside edge. Stokes there takes a really smart, fast-reaction catch! He has a surprised smile on his face and with good reason as well. He cannot believe how he has taken that one himself. Anyway, Afghanistan in deep, deep trouble here!
Rashid Khan walks out next to bat.

OUT! Hardly in the frame. Flighted ball outside off, Nabi strokes it through covers. The sweeper cover comes in and gathers it. They complete the two but take on the arms of Jonny Bairstow. He throws it at the keeper's end. The throw is a very good one. Buttler whips the bails off quickly. The square leg umpire takes it upstairs. Replays roll in and confirm that Najibullah Zadran was well short.
Najibullah Zadran the man in question and it looked out to the naked eye. That was a suicidal run and the throw was perfect too. The umpire though goes upstairs to make sure!
Another run out appeal!
Shorter on off, Zadran punches it to covers for a run.
Leg spinner but it ends up being a full toss on the pads, Nabi flicks it to deep square leg and gets a single.
Flatter ball on middle, defended well by Zadran coming ahead.
Mohammad Nabi is the new man in.

OUT! The sixth one goes down! That is straight down the throat of the long on fielder. The second wicket of the over! A flighted ball outside off, Naib takes the invitation to hit it over long on but fails to get it over the fielder. He hits it straight and the ball does not have the strength to clear the ground. Stokes runs to his left and takes a smart catch. Afghanistan in massive trouble here, throwing their wickets away really.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball back down.

OUT! Shahidi has thrown his wicket away with an unnecessary run out. A flatter ball on the pads, turned towards square leg by Naib. The batsmen decide to go for the risky second. That though is the wrong decision they make as Plunkett in the deep throws the ball right on top of the stumps at the bowler's end and Ali removes the bails. The umpire takes it upstairs where the replays show that Hashmatullah is short. Half the side back in the hut now! Najibullah Zadran is the new man in to the crease.
Run out appeal taken upstairs! Shahidi is the man in question, Ali at the non-striker's end seems confident that he has got his man in time!
FOUR! Crunched away! Short outside off, cut away hard by Naib through point. The ball beats the fielder at the boundary easily.

Flatter off-spinner on middle and leg, Naib tries to turn this away through square leg but misses the ball. It goes off the pads towards the off side. The impact was outside leg so there is no appeal.
On the pads, Naib flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has played it to the point region. They pick up a single.
Shorter on off, GN punches it to deep cover for a single.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Naib strokes it straight to mid on.
On the pads once again, HS glances it to mid-wicket for a single.
On the pads, Naib turns it away to fine leg for a run.
Short and punches straight to cover.
Floated on middle and leg, Naib milks it to long on for one.
Floated on off, Shahidi comes down the track and drives it to long off for a single.
On middle and leg, HS flicks it to mid-wicket.
Off spinner pitching on middle and leg, Shahidi looks to flick but misses. The ball hits him on his pad. The bowler and the keeper go up in appeal but the umpire is not interested.
Tosses it up on middle and leg, Shahidi taps it back to the bowler.
Punched back through mid on by Hashmatullah. A single is taken and Hashmatullah will be back on strike.
Shahidi comes forward and defends this ball to mid-wicket.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Shahidi comes a little down the track and then pushes this ball to the point fielder.
Around the wicket to the southpaw, bowled flatter on middle. Pushed back to the bowler by the southpaw.
Bowled flatter on the leg stump line, eased away to mid-wicket for a single by the skipper.

Moeen tosses it up on off, Naib strokes it wide of mid on. The fielder there dives to his left and looks to stop it with a dive but cannot do it. The ball deflects off him and goes behind. They take a single.
Floats it on off, Naib drives it straight. It is so straight that it hits the stumps.
Tossed up on off, Naib drives it to point.
Short on middle, Naib punches it to the man at mid on.
Floated outside off, Naib strokes it to the man at cover.
Starts with a shorter ball around off, Naib hits it straight back to the bowler.
Spin from both ends. Moeen Ali comes on to bowl now.
Outside off, Shahidi pushes it to cover.
Tossed up on middle, Naib strokes it to the right of diving Root to long on for a single.
On the pads, Shahidi flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
Flighted on off, Naib drives it to long on for one.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Shahidi comes down the track and milks it to long on for a single.
Shorter on off, Shahidi strokes it to the man at mid off.
Low full toss outside off, Naib takes it on the full before driving it on a bounce to the cover fielder.
Stokes goes wide of the crease to deliver this ball but it wide outside off. Gulbadin drives this ball towards cover.
Patted back down the ground to the bowler this time by Naib.
Bouncer on middle, the batsman is not interested and lets the ball go through.
Well outside off, left alone by the skipper.
Bowled back of a length on middle, Shahidi opens the face of the bat and gets the ball to go through cover-point for a run.
Once again bowls a leg spinner to the right-hander. It os on off, Naib defends it to see off the over.
Good shot for a single. Root tosses it up on off, Shahidi beautifully drives it to long off for a single.
Flighted on off, Shahidi drives it to the man at cover.
Root bowls a leg spinner. He is trying variations here. It is on the pads, Naib glances it to square leg and gets off the mark.
The skipper, Gulbadin Naib walks out at number 6.

OUT! Root strikes in his first over as well. The break has brought in a lapse of concentration for Afghan. Root tosses it up nicely on off, Asghar looks to heave it over long on. He does not time it well and hits it straight to Jason Roy stationed at long on. He takes an easy catch.
Starts with a full toss on middle and off, Afghan hits it straight to mid-wicket. Will feel he has missed on an oppurtunity there.

Drinks break! England have started this warm-up beautifully. They bowled with pace and precision in the first 10 overs where they picked 2 wickets. Stokes came on and struck in his first over as well. Afghanistan have found the going tough but now Afghan and Shahidi are settling in slowly. Time for them to stitch a big stand here. Spin after the break for the English, Joe Root is into the attack.
Short ball outside off, Shahidi looks to ramp this over slips. He misses the ball.
Pushed to the cover region by the southpaw.

Bowled on the hips, Afghan looks to work it fine on the leg side but it goes off the handle and a part of the glove towards the left of the keeper where Buttler dives and stops it. Cannot prevent the single though.
Good bouncer! The batsman ducks under the ball at the last moment.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.

FOUR! Cut away hard! The short boundary that side and Afghan takes full toll. A ball wide outside off, Asghar transfers the weight on the back foot and then cuts it easily past point. Beats third man with ease.
Flicks it uppishly towards deep square leg and keeps the strike with a single.
Full outside off, Shahidi strokes it to deep point and gets to the other end.
Full to follow it up. HS pushes it to point.
Bouncer again. This is the clearly the plan here from England.It is once again well directed as it is on the body. Shahidi does not take any risk and ducks under it once again.
Full now on off, Shahidi defends it off the front foot.
Short and coming in with the angle. Shahidi ducks under it.
On off, Afgan defends it to see off the over.
Another play and miss. Full outside off, Asghar looks to drive it but misses. Stokes looks in good rhythm today. A positive sign for all the English fans.
Outside off and full, Shahidi drives it to sweeper cover for a run.
Now fuller on off, Shahidi pushes it to the man at cover.
Brilliantly directed bouncer. It is on the body and bowled at 139 kph. Shahidi does well to get down in time.
Good length ball on middle, Afghan looks to flick it but gets an inside edge which lobs towards the square leg region off the pads for a single.
Pushed towards the off side by Shahidi to end the over.
From around the wicket to the southpaw again, it is a slower-ball yorker. Well kept out towards the bowler by Hashmatullah.
Worked off the pads to fine leg for a single by Afghan.
Pushed towards deep cover for a run by the southpaw.
FOUR! Shot of the day so far! A fuller length ball outside off, Shahidi gets into position nice and early before leaning into this drive. Gets it in the gap as well wide of deep cover.
Good length ball on middle, Afghan turns it through square leg for a single. The bat turned in his hand as he played that shot.
50 up for Afghanistan and Afghan is off the mark too. On the pads, Asghar flicks it towards mid-wicket and keeps the strike with a single. Tidy start from Stokes. 6 runs and a wicket.
Length ball on the stumps, Afghan defends it.
Asghar Afghan walks out to bat now.

OUT! Bowled! Stokes bowls it on a length. He hits the deck hard on middle and off. The ball comes in slightly after pitching. Noor Ali looks to defend but it gets an inside edge and the ball goes on to hit the top of middle and leg. Stokes strikes in his very first over. Afghanistan have lost their third.
Now bowls it full on off, Noor Ali defends it off the front foot. Shows good composure there to follow the boundary with a dot.
FOUR! Brilliantly pulled. There is a fine leg in place just for that. Stokes bowls it short but Noor Ali pulls it fine of the man at fine leg and gets a boundary.
Stokes bowls it full around off, Shahidi runs it down to third man for a single.
Ben Stokes has been brought on now.
Good length ball on middle and leg, Ali Zadran flicks it to mid-wicket.
Curran pulls his length back Ali Zadran defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! What a flick! Gull on middle and off, Noor Ali moves to the line of the ball and flicks it over mid on for a boundary.
Outside off now, Shahidi drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Full on off, Shahidi drives it straight to the man at short cover.
Starts with a length ball onn the pads, Noor Ali flicks it to square leg and gets to the other end.
Powerplay 2 signalled by the umpire. Now 4 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over. Tom Curran now into the attack.
Maiden over! On a length on middle and leg, patted right back to Woakes by Hashmatullah. England's Powerplay! Afghanistan are 38/2 at end of 10 overs.
Driven hard towards cover by the southpaw this time.
Slightly back of a length and on top of middle, patted back on the surface towards the bowler.
Good ball right on the money! Well defended by Shahidi though back down the ground.
Fuller this time, driven down to mid off by the southpaw.
Good length ball outside off, pushed off the back foot towards mid off.
FOUR! The over has ended just the way it has started. On the pads this time, Noor Ali flicks it wide of square leg and gets a boundary. Two boundaries sandwiched between 4 dots to finish the over.
Short again. This time on the body, Noor Ali once again ducks under it.
Good length ball on the pads, Noor Ali flicks it to the man at square leg.
Bouncer on off, Noor Ali sits under it and lets it carry to the keeper.
Fuller on off, Ali Zadran defends it.

FOUR! Slower ball gone wrong. Archer tries to surprise the batsman with a 116 kph ball outside off, Noor Ali looks to whack it over point but gets a thick outside edge which flies over the slip cordon for a boundary.
Fuller length outside off, driven towards mid off by Shahidi.
Back of a length outside off, punched towards cover-point by the southpaw.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
On the money again from Woakes, defended back down the ground by HS.
That pinged off the middle of the bat but goes to straight to Stokes at cover. Good shot but no placement.
Bowled on the hips, tucked away to fine leg by Noor Ali for a single.
Bouncer! It is bowled at 146 kph outside off, Shahidi sways away from it.

That was not far away from a disastrous run out. Shahidi gets a ball on the pads, he flicks it through mid-wicket. Ben Stokes gives it a chase and stops it. They get two. Shahidi comes halfway down the track for the third but Noor Ali was not aware that he had come for the third so he sends him back. The throw from Stokes at the keeper's end is a very poor one. It goes to backward point and Shahidi is back in his crease.
Back of a length ball on off, HS blocks it off his back foot.
Play and a miss! Good ball from Archer. Fuller outside off. Archer holds the seam beautifully. Shahidi has a poke at it but misses. The ball just misses his outside edge.

Shahidi is on the ground! He has been hit right on his crown jewels by a pacy Archer delivery. The physio comes running in, maybe time for some magic spray. Nice to see him back on his feet and taking some time to compose himself by a little jogging!

Ouch! Right on the box. That must be painful and we all know. Good length ball on middle and leg, it comes in after pitching. Shahidi looks to defend but he misses and the ball hits him hard. He straightaway goes down wincing in pain.
Comes 'round the wicket and cramps the batsman for room bu bowling it closer to the body. Shahidi flicks it to mid-wicket.
Length ball on off, Ali Zadran defends it off his front foot.
On the stumps, Noor Ali blocks it.
Length ball coming in to the batsman. It is pitched on middle and leg, Noor Ali looks to flick it but gets hit high on the thigh pad.

In the air...but safe. The idea was right, the timing was not. Good length ball on off and middle, Noor Ali comes down the track and looks to hit it over short mid-wicket. He does not time it well so it does not even go close to the fence but he times it well enough to hit it over and away from the fielder and get a couple.
Once again Woakes targets the stumps and Noor Ali blocks it.
Length ball on off, Ali Zadran defends it within the crease.
The new man in is Hashmatullah Shahidi.

OUT! Soft dismissal! Archer bowls it back of a length. He hits the pitch hard. Rahmat looks to play the pull but he is late on his shot. He ends up chipping it straight to mid on. Liam Plunkett there takes a dolly. Second wicket for Jofra in the game. Rahmat Shah, arguably Afghanistan's current best batsman departs. He has made just 35 runs in the two warm-up games combined.
On off, Shah pushes it to cover.
Length ball on off, Noor Ali times his drive through cover. Moeen Ali gives it a chase and pulls it back before the ropes. Ben Stokes throws it and they get three.
Good length ball around off, Noor Ali defends it off the back foot.
Good shot! Noor Ali  takes his front leg out of the way and slashes it past point. The ball does not get to the fence as the fielder mops it. They get two.
Jofra hits the deck hard on a length. It is on off,  Noor Ali taps it to point.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
What a jaffa! A length ball outside off, swinging away and beats the outside edge as Rahmat tries to defend the ball towards the off side.
Slightly back of a length on off and some inswing on that, Rahmat misses the ball and gets hit high on the thigh pad.
On middle and leg this time, worked through mid-wicket for a couple of runs by Shah.
Well left in the end one would have to say. A length ball outside off and coming in late, Rahmat covers the stumps and then lets the ball go to the keeper. Good technique.
Good ball on a length just outside off, watchfully defended back to the bowler by Rahmat.
Good length ball on  off, Ali Zadran defends it off the back foot to see off the over.
Short ball around off, Noor Ali sways away from it.
On off, Noor Ali taps it to the man at point.
Good length ball on off, Rahmat plays it with soft hands towards third man and gets off the mark.
Outside off on a good length, good pace and good followthrough quips Wasim Akram on air. Well left by Rahmat.
Rahmat Shah walks out at number 3.

OUT! High in the air and taken easily by Moeen Ali at mid on. A length ball from around the wicket, Zazai wants to pull it away after backing away but the ball hits him high on the bat and goes straight up and with absolutely no distance. Moeen has the simplest of catches that he completes. Jofra strikes, must give him so much confidence before the big tournament to pick up these early wickets.
Dot to finish the over. End of an eventful over from Chris Woakes. The last ball is on middle and leg, Noor Ali rocks onto his back foot and blocks it.
FOUR! Excellent shot! Length ball outside off, Ali Zadran gets on his back foot and slashes it through covers for a boundary.

NOT OUT! There is no bat and the ball has grazed his elbow on its way to the keeper. Back of a length ball pitching on off, Ali Zadran looks to defend but misses. There was a noise as it goes to the keeper. The England players are confident and go up in a strong appeal. The umpire agrees and raises his finger. Noor Ali straightaway takes it upstairs. Replays roll in and the Ultra Edge shows that it clipped his elbow. Afghanistan retain their review.
Review time! Noor Ali has been adjudged caught behind here but he has reviewed straightaway. Let's see what the replays say, maybe the ball hasn't hit the bat...
Good length ball on off, Rahamat plays it owith soft hands towards third man and gets off the mark with a single.
Outside off on a length, Noor Ali leaves it alone.
WIDE! Woakes misses his line and bowls it down the leg side. Ali Zadran looks to flick it but misses. Wide signalled.

Right on the money. Good length ball pitching on middle and off. It tails away after pitching. Noor Ali looks to defend but gets an outside edge. He plays it with soft hands and hence it goes to second slip on a bounce.
Chris Woakes to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
FOUR! Two in two. What a great start for Afghanistan. Length ball outside off, Jofra gives width and Zazai smashes it over point to finish the over with a boundary. 12 off the first one.
FOUR! Pulled and pulled fine. It is short on the body, Zazai pulls it fine down the fine leg region for a boundary. First one off the day.
On the pads, Zazai flicks it towards square leg and gets a brace as the fielder from circle stops the ball before the ropes.
Good length ball on off, Zazai blocks it.
Length ball outside off, Noor Ali also does not waste any time. He taps it down to third man and gets off the mark himself.
Afghanistan are off the mark. Jofra starts with a good length delivery outside off, Zazai runs it down to third man and straightaway gets off the mark.

We are all set to begin. The umpires are out in the middle. The English players follow them out on the field. Hazratullah Zazai and Noor Ali Zadran to open the innings for Afghanistan. Jofra Archer has the first new ball in hand for England.

Afghanistan skipper, Gulbadin Naib says they are ready to test themselves against the pace and informs they were looking to bat first anyway. Says the guys are excited after the win against Pakistan and hopes they can play good cricket here and informs Mujeeb and Shahazad have been rested for this warm up.

England skipper, Eoin Morgan says they are playing Afghanistan and as they are playing against Afghanistan in Manchester in the tournament where they would bowl first hence this decision. On playing quality spin he says they have been excellent and they bring in a good energy. On the pitch he says it is a used wicket and tells Oval is a fantastic pitch and they are looking good. Informs Plunkett, Wood and Dawson area out and they are playing 12. Says they would like to have good batting and bowling Powerplay. Ends by saying it is important to find the balance in the most important part of the game and winning it.
TOSS - Eoin Morgan has the coin in hand. Up is goes Gulbadin Naib calls it heads and it lands in favor of England. England will bowl first.

Pitch Report - Mark Ramprakash and Wasim Akram are the pitch analyst for the game. Mark starts by informing that we are playing the same strip where India played against New Zealand. Tells the boundary on the off side is just 56m where it is 70m on the other side. Wasim Akram standing on the other side of the wicket says he relishes this pitch as there is a nice grass covering on it but informs it has been a batters paradise as the average score since 2015 has been 291 here. But ends by saying as there is grass covering on this pitch it will suit the bowlers and they should look to hit the right areas.

Hello and welcome to the final warm up game of the hosts and Afghanistan. After their loss against Australia in the warm up game, England will be looking to prove a point and show why they are the favorites heading into the tournament. They missed the services of skipper Eoin Morgan in the previous game and he should be back. Afghanistan on the other hand will be up in confidence and will be looking to make it two in two before they head into the main event. It will be a good test for the English players against the Afghan spinners. It should be a good game.
